title: PlannerConfirmRequest
description: The `backlog-planner` `POST /plans/{id}/confirm` request body (`youtrack/planner/src/backlog_planner/api.py`'s `ConfirmBody`). The whole body is optional -- an absent body means 'confirm everything proposed, unchanged'. Fields and links are deliberately not accepted here (D111 clause 2): only deselecting an issue and editing its title/description.

issues.description: Leaving an issue's `key` out of this array deselects it. Absent (the whole property missing) means 'all, unchanged'.

areas.description: The Area values kept, for a new project only. Absent means 'all proposed'.
